name: Fleet observability and identity
description: Validate status, progress, logs, groups, workspace identity, and pane identity as one observability system.

variants.description: Exercise metadata and grouping APIs on deterministic run-owned workspaces without relying on screenshots.
setup: Create a run-owned workspace group and deterministic role roster with unique reviewer, fixer, tester, and builder identities.
Record stable workspace and surface IDs and prepare an expected metadata state table.
exercise: Apply role names, descriptions, colors, icons, status transitions, progress, and logs; create and collapse scale groups using empty workspaces.
Create one four-pane workspace and apply distinct tab names plus nonce-tagged ANSI role banners without modifying shell profile files.

assertions.expectation: Each role workspace exposes the expected working-to-done or working-to-error status, progress, and log sequence through APIs.
Every scale workspace belongs to the intended named group, collapse state is queryable, and anchor ownership is recorded.
Names, descriptions, colors, and icons match the expected table for every owned workspace.
The four role surfaces have unique tab names and nonce-tagged banners while no persistent shell config changes.
Groups are dismantled in anchor-safe order and all run-owned workspaces are removed.

cleanup: Close group members before anchors, then close the role and four-pane workspaces by stable ID.
Confirm no shell profile or unrelated Cmux metadata changed.

variants.description: Visually confirm the native sidebar, progress, groups, role labels, and pane banners after API state passes.
setup: Run the deterministic state fixture in a dedicated visible Cmux window using a bounded number of representative workspaces.
Prepare a visual checklist derived from the already-asserted state table.
exercise: Inspect expanded and collapsed groups, status colors, progress labels, workspace icons, pane tab names, banners, and targeted flash behavior.
Capture minimal visual evidence only after machine-readable state assertions succeed.

assertions.expectation: Workspace groups, colors, icons, status pills, and progress bars render consistently with the state table.
Reviewer, fixer, tester, and builder panes are distinguishable by tab title and banner without per-pane theme claims.
Targeted flash highlights only the selected owned workspace or surface.
Closing the fixture restores the sidebar and window to their baseline state.

cleanup: Remove visual evidence that contains unrelated user UI or redact it before retention.
Close all run-owned workspaces and the dedicated window if it was created by the run.
